process_description: Serve a template page declared in the page manifest. Applies the PAGE_CONTRACTS guard (user cookie, valid storage session, role membership) before rendering; redirects via SSOT navigation on denial. Renders the Jinja2 template with standard context (page_id, page_title, contract, user info); falls back to a placeholder page when the template file does not exist yet. Routes are generated dynamically from PAGE_MANIFEST at import time — routes already owned by dedicated handlers are skipped.
